# Hivig — Hi-Tech Vigilance for the Agentic Age
> Independent intelligence on agentic AI: platform verdicts, implementation
> guides, and fearless analysis — no vendor sponsorships, ever. Also home to
> The Race (a live AI model leaderboard) and the Agent Store (an on-demand
> AI agent marketplace).

## Editorial
- /intel — article index (Deep Dives, How-To, Watchdog, Opinion, Fact-Checked)
- /intel/{slug} — individual articles
- /manifesto — what Hivig stands for
- /about — origin, mission, editorial standards
- /consultancy — independent AI agent implementation consulting
- /subscribe — join the mailing list

## The Race
- /race — live leaderboard, all tracked AI models
- /race/models/{slug} — individual model detail pages
- /race/methodology — how rankings are computed

## Agent Store
- /agents — describe an agent, get a price quote
- /agents/discover — instant, AI-generated feasibility study + quote
- /agents/pricing — how quotes are calculated

## Legal
- /legal/privacy
- /legal/terms
